HAND SCALE / Reflective surfaces, fire & forms

Catoptromancy / mirror gazing.

Contemplating or interpreting images seen in a reflective surface, including a dark mirror.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Catoptromancy
Catoptromancia

A divinatory reading using a mirror or reflected images.

Mirror gazing
Observación de espejos

Sustained visual attention to a reflective surface; the aim may be contemplative or symbolic.

Dark mirror
Espejo oscuro

A dark reflective surface used as a gazing object in some scrying practices.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Mirrors and crystals occur in several scrying traditions. The instrument, lighting and viewing angle shape the visible image; the tradition supplies a separate interpretive vocabulary.

Hand scaleHuman scaleMatter

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Record the mirror type, room lighting and viewing distance.
  2. Describe reflections, visual changes and impressions in separate notes.
  3. Name the source used for any symbolic reading.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Photograph the mirror with its edges and surrounding light visible.
  • Add one image from the viewing angle; avoid including bystanders or private reflections.

POTPOURRI / PERSONAL INTERPRETATION

Share a photograph or a record.

A photograph, drawing or dated record can be sent privately for a personal reading. Include the procedure and the question.
